data.raw_text:
Anime culture goes crazy here in the Philippines. 

IP is deeply imbedded in Philippine culture. In the rally against corruption, some chose to dress up as Naruto, Spiderman, Batman. Raising OnePiece flags. 

Gatcha, funko pop, popmart, and other IP collectors items are selling like hotcakes. Now imagine a web3 IP. 

IMO this is the best place to build a web3 IP. People are constantly curious, Filipinos will be intrigued. 

Building here guarantees you a market. And trust me, marketing is much more easier here than bigger countries.
